WhisperOfTheForest.Rituals.RitualDef.label: rite of the woven spellbook
WhisperOfTheForest.Rituals.RitualDef.description: Takes one apprentice spellbook, 12 elven steel and 15 jade from the ground around the altar when the chant completes. A 5×5 green crafting circle produces one adept spellbook on completion. Spells remain with their pawn; wearing the new book opens seven slots without erasing stored recipes.

WhisperOfTheForest.Rituals.RitualDef.label: rite of the starlight codex
WhisperOfTheForest.Rituals.RitualDef.description: Takes one adept spellbook, 12 mithril and 10 star chalk from the ground around the altar when the chant completes. A 7×7 star crafting circle produces one starlight codex on completion. Spells remain with their pawn; the codex opens all ten slots and permits super runes.
